I'll analyze this Coinglass Fear & Greed Index page in detail to help you recreate the design accurately:

## 1. Semicircle Gauge Analysis

**Arc Thickness & Structure:**
- The gauge is a semi-circular arc with a medium thickness (approximately 15-20px)
- The arc spans from left (Extreme Fear) to right (Extreme Greed) in a 180-degree arc
- The arc has a white/very light gray background with a colored gradient overlay

**Color Transitions (Exact Hex Colors):**
- **Extreme Fear (Left):** Green (#4ade80 or similar bright green)
- **Fear:** Light green transitioning to yellow (#facc15)
- **Neutral:** Yellow (#facc15)
- **Greed:** Yellow transitioning to orange (#fb923c)
- **Extreme Greed (Right):** Red/orange (#f87171 or similar red)

**Needle Shape & Color:**
- The needle is triangular with a rounded tip
- Color: Dark green (#16a34a)
- Positioned at the "Extreme Fear" section (value of 9)
- Needle has a slight shadow or 3D effect for depth

**Number Positions:**
- Numbers 0-100 are positioned along the inner edge of the arc
- Small tick marks accompany each number
- The current value "9" is prominently displayed in the center-bottom of the gauge

**Label Positions:**
- "Extreme Fear" at the far left
- "Fear" in the left-middle
- "Neutral" at the top-center
- "Greed" in the right-middle
- "Extreme Greed" at the far right

## 2. Stats Section Layout

**Layout:**
- Positioned to the right of the gauge
- Contains a table with 5 rows of data
- Each row has a label on the left and a value on the right

**Spacing & Alignment:**
- Consistent vertical spacing between rows (approximately 24px)
- Left-aligned labels, right-aligned values
- Values have a secondary percentage in parentheses

**Font Sizes:**
- Labels: ~14px, regular weight
- Values: ~16px, bold
- Percentages: ~12px, regular weight, lighter color

**Content:**
- Extreme Fear: 395 days (13.04%)
- Fear: 947 days (31.26%)
- Neutral: 798
- Greed: 740
- Extreme Greed: 149 days (4.92%)

## 3. Tab Buttons Design

**Colors & Borders:**
- Background: White (#ffffff)
- Border: Light gray (#e5e7eb)
- Text: Dark gray (#374151)

**Selected State:**
- Selected tab has a blue background (#3b82f6)
- White text (#ffffff)
- Slightly rounded corners

**Tabs Available:**
- "All" (selected)
- "1 week"
- "1 month" 
- "1 Year"

## 4. Value Display

- Current value "9" is prominently displayed in the center-bottom of the gauge
- Large font size (approximately 48px)
- Bold weight
- Dark gray/black color (#1f2937)

## 5. Overall Card/Container Styling

**Container:**
- White background (#ffffff)
- Rounded corners (8-10px)
- Subtle shadow (very light, almost imperceptible)
- Padding: approximately 24px on all sides

**Header:**
- "Crypto Fear & Greed Index" title
- Font size: ~20px
- Font weight: bold
- Margin-bottom: 24px

## 6. Background Colors

**Page Background:**
- Very light gray (#f9fafb) - almost white

**Card Background:**
- Pure white (#ffffff)

## Additional Details

- The gauge has small tick marks along the arc at regular intervals
- There's a legend button in the bottom right with a pink "NEW" badge
- The page has a left sidebar with various metric options
- Top navigation bar with Coinglass branding and menu items
- Banner advertisement in the middle of the page
- Dark mode toggle in the top right corner

This detailed breakdown should help you recreate the Fear & Greed Index gauge and surrounding elements with high fidelity to the original design.
